verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Ollama exposes OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible APIs and integrates with agentic coding tools like Claude Code and Codex, which implies some tool-calling capability, but no evidence explicitly documents native tool-calling schemas or reasoning-parser (e.g., thinking-token) support in its API. missing for 10: explicit docs on tool-calling API parameters/response format, explicit reasoning-parser/thinking-tag handling, and independent confirmation these work reliably.
